glosses: semester, term (at a school or university)

examples.en: She is working hard this semester.

examples.text: J'ai encore le livre du semestre dernier.
examples.en: I still have the book from last semester.

examples.text: Il y a deux examens ce semestre.
examples.en: We have two examinations during this term.

examples.text: J'étudierai le français au prochain semestre.
examples.en: I'm going to study French next semester.
